title: Close audit delivery coverage and exclude local attachments
summary: Close strict branch-diff coverage for accumulated audit-remediation paths and exclude Codex-local attachment artifacts from Git delivery.
reason: The cumulative remediation branch is otherwise packet-covered, but fourteen previously committed paths lack explicit packet disposition and nine local Codex attachment images must not enter the pull request.
behavior_before: Strict branch-diff validation reports uncovered remediation paths and the cumulative branch carries local Codex attachment images inherited from earlier history.
behavior_after: All retained remediation paths have explicit packet coverage, and the attachment directory is removed and ignored for future local sessions.
manual_validation: secret-pattern and large-file preflight - passed; attachments excluded
rollback_plan: Revert this packet and the .gitignore entry only if Codex-local attachments intentionally become repository assets; the removed images remain recoverable from pre-delivery branch history.
notes: Delivery-only packet. It does not alter media behavior. Retained paths were already part of the accumulated remediation work and are listed here to make branch-diff ownership explicit.
